lines.text: The watchmen are blind mute dogs, and the shepherds have no discernment and each seeks his own gain.
They burn with lust among the oaks, slaughter their children in the valleys, and pour drink offerings to smooth stones.
They went to Chemosh with oil and multiplied their perfumes, and they descended even to Sheol itself.
The wind will carry off the idols, but whoever seeks refuge in God will possess Mount Sinai.
The high and lifted up One, whose name is Holy, dwells with the oppressed and humble in spirit.
